sheetBody: Others get your methods and map. Never your holdings, what you follow, Journal, chats or saved files.
principlesNote: Your own principles. Read them before sharing.
leftOut: Left out: {{formattedCount}} relationships that rest only on your own files or connections
leftOutLicense_one: Left out: {{formattedCount}} item whose license doesn't allow sharing
leftOutLicense_other: Left out: {{formattedCount}} items whose license doesn't allow sharing
findingKey: {{kind}} “{{item}}” contains what looks like a password or API key.
findingAccount: {{kind}} “{{item}}” contains what looks like an account or card number.
findingHolding: {{kind}} “{{item}}” mentions how much you hold of {{symbol}}.
findingPersonal: {{kind}} “{{item}}” contains an email, phone number or your name.
blockedReason: Leave out the flagged items first.
conflictReason: Leave out some of the items whose licenses clash first.

licenseSummary.byNcSa: Anyone can share and adapt it with credit, not for commercial use, and must keep the same license.
licenseSummary.byNc: Anyone can share and adapt it with credit, not for commercial use.
licenseSummary.by: Anyone can share and adapt it for any purpose, with credit.
licenseSummary.bySa: Anyone can share and adapt it for any purpose, with credit, and must keep the same license.
licenseSummary.zero: Anyone can use it for any purpose, with no conditions.

notRedistributable: For your use only. You can't share these items again.
licenseConflict: Some items came from shared Loupists under licenses that can't be shared together. Leave some of them out to choose a license.
licenseFixed: Set by the license of items that came from shared Loupists.
nothing: There's nothing to share yet. Methods and the map grow as you research.
turnOnOne: Turn on at least one part.
githubMissing: GitHub publishing isn't available in this version. Save as a folder, then upload it to GitHub yourself.
gistNote: A GitHub gist is a one-page post on GitHub that people open with its link.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Try again.
listNote: It appears after automatic checks pass, usually within minutes. Anyone can list a Loupist; nobody reviews it by hand.
listingTerms: I agree to the <0>Gallery listing terms</0>
listFailed: The Gallery check didn't pass. Open the request on GitHub to see why.
publishOffline: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your connection, then try again.
rateLimited: GitHub asked to slow down. Try again in a few minutes.
nameTaken: You already have a repository with that name. Choose another.
repoMismatch: That repository now holds something else. Publish as a new repository.
publishDenied: GitHub didn't allow this. Sign in again.
ghScope: Loupist can create and update public repositories and GitHub gists on your account. It only changes the ones it creates. Your sign-in stays on this Mac.
ghDenied: You didn't allow it. Nothing was shared.
fromShared: Or start from a shared Loupist
galleryBody: Loupists shared by the community. Anyone can list one, so you review everything before it's added.
search: Search by name, focus or author
galleryOffline: You're offline. Showing the list from {{date}}.
galleryUnavailable: The Gallery couldn't load. You can still use a link or file.
galleryNoMatch: No shared Loupists match. Try other words or clear the filters.
linkHint: A repository, folder or gist (a one-page GitHub post) on github.com
linkInvalid: Use a github.com or gist.github.com link.
linkNotFound: This link isn't public, or it moved.
safetyNoAuthority: Shared Loupists can't change settings, tools, connections or what your Loupist may save.

flag.instruction: Looks like an instruction to the AI
flag.tool: Names an app tool, file or setting
flag.secret: Asks for passwords, keys or accounts
flag.link: Has a link that could send data out

mergeNote: Your principles and perspective stay as they are.
addNote: Methods and principles arrive as suggestions you accept.
addFailed: Couldn't finish adding. Nothing was kept; try again.

invalid.newer: It was made by a newer Loupist. Update the app, then try again.
invalid.tooLarge: It's larger than 16 MB or has too many files.
invalid.unsafe: It carries files a shared Loupist may not carry, such as programs, links or settings.
invalid.damaged: Some files are damaged or were changed after sharing.
invalid.spoof: It contains text made to look like the app's own safety markers.

acceptFlaggedNote: The AI will treat this text with extra caution, and some tools pause in answers that use it.
youEdited: You changed this. Theirs is shown beside yours.
originGone: The original link no longer works. What you added stays.
differentPack: That copy is a different shared Loupist.
removeConfirm: Remove {{names}} names and {{links}} relationships that came only from {{pack}}?
removeArchive: Also archive the {{formattedCount}} methods and principles you accepted
removeDone: Removed. Your own research is untouched.
reportNote: Opens a report form on GitHub. Only this Loupist's link is filled in.
removedBanner: Removed from the Gallery {{reason}}. You can remove what it added.
safetyBlocked: Removed from the Gallery {{reason}}. It can't be added.
deepBody: This link opens a shared Loupist from GitHub. Links can come from anywhere, so you'll see everything before anything is added.
